Real estate and land

Capital recycling

تدوير رأس المال

Also called: asset recycling

Definition

Capital recycling is releasing capital from an asset once it earns, through refinancing or a sale, and reinvesting that capital in the next asset.

What it means

An asset with steady income can support new financing, or attract a buyer or a fund. The owner uses that to take out part of the capital invested, rather than leaving it tied up in one asset, and puts it to work on the next one.

The cycle depends on records that lenders and investors trust: a history of income, an up-to-date model and complete documents.

How HAYKALAH uses it

Capital recycling is the last step of HAYKALAH’s asset-monetization engine, Audit → Optimize → Structure → Operate → Monetize: recurring income supports refinancing, and released capital moves to the next asset. Monetization, one of HAYKALAH’s six ways of creating value, turns idle land, buildings and facilities into income, refinancing capacity and capital to recycle.
